description: The AWS services the adapters of the application call, by the name of their VPC endpoint (com.amazonaws.<region>.<name>), with what calls each one. tests/Unit/Support/AwsServicesTest.php checks this list against the code; the CDK app gives each service a path from the private subnets of the functions (infra/cdk/lib/network-stack.ts), and docs/infrastructure.md lists the paths.

services.dynamodb: The cache, the web sessions and the rate limits (Laravel's DynamoDB store)
services.email: Email (Laravel's mailer over the SES v2 API)
services.kms: The key store of the signing certificates (KmsKeyStore)
services.secretsmanager: The secrets of the application and of the database identities (LoadSecrets, the MySQL connector of the functions)
services.sns: The outbox events, published to the topic (SnsOutboxPublisher)
services.sqs: The jobs the application dispatches to the chain queue, and the visibility of the messages of the consumers (SqsEventsQueue)
